_comment: ccrl_err is the CCRL list's own +- (95%, as printed) for the anchors in the queue ladder, read from the CCRL Blitz single-CPU list on 2026-11-07; scripts/ccrl_ladder.py propagates it into the CI and assumes +-20 for anchors without one. Elite CCRL Blitz anchor set (2615-3631) for rustfish at ~2650-2700+. Ratings from the CCRL Blitz complete list dated 2026-10-27 (+-13..18 each, single-CPU entries); the 3000-3210 anchors added on 2026-11-02 use the 2026-10-31 list and were built and UCI-smoke-tested locally (viridithas-4.0.0, black-marlin-4.0, stash-28/30/31). Same build kinds as scripts/anchors.json; all are HCE except reckless-0.3.0/0.4.0 (net embedded from data/weights.bin in-repo); no build-time net downloads. simbelmyne-1.7.0 pulls crates.io deps via its Cargo.lock (clap, rayon, ...); all others are dependency-free. Risks: stash v21.0/v25.0 build with -Werror (newer GCC warnings could break them; v19/v20.0.1 built fine); zahak 6.2 has no Book UCI option (book is off unless -book is passed). Excluded from the 3000+ additions: Smallbrain 4.0.0 (types.h uses uint8_t without <cstdint>, fails on GCC 13) and Princhess 0.17.0 (bindgen needs libclang, absent on the runners); Smallbrain 5.0.0 is 3221, outside the target band. Excluded: Blunder 7.x/8.x (RunCommLoop and UCILoop each wrap stdin in their own bufio.Reader, so piped smoke input after 'uci' is swallowed: the cause of the 6.1.0/7.4.0 'go depth 4' failures, and 8.5.5 has the same pattern); Zahak 7.1 (needs 'make netgen' to generate engine/nn.go); Velvet 2.0.0 (packed_simd_2, nightly only); Pedantic (C#). Select with: gh workflow run ccrl-ladder.yml -f anchors_file=scripts/anchors-elite.json black-marlin-4.0 removed 2026-11-06: it scored 15-20% against rustfish while 3150-3210 anchors scored ~50%, so its build is broken (likely missing its net) and it inflated fits by ~30 Elo. 3273-3491 anchors added 2026-11-06 from the 2026-10-31 list (single-CPU entries, +-8..15), built and smoke-tested only on CI: stash-33/35/37 (HCE), weiss-2.0 (HCE; WARN=-Wall drops its -Werror, which GCC on the runners trips in pyrrhic), reckless-0.6.0 (net in repo), koivisto-6.0 and reckless-0.7.0 (their nets live outside the repo: the workflow fetches them from a commit-pinned net_url and checks net_sha256 before building, so a missing or wrong net fails the build instead of silently playing weak, the black-marlin failure mode). Kind 'make' runs make -C <dir> <make_args> and copies <out>. 3525-3631 anchors added 2026-11-07 from the CCRL Blitz single-CPU list computed 2026-11-07 (carp-3.0.1 3525+-8, berserk-8 3553+-14, altair-7.0.0 3579+-10, koivisto-8.0 3590+-10, koivisto-9.0 3631+-7), built and smoke-tested only on CI: carp, berserk and altair embed their nets from the repo (bins/net.bin, src/default.nn, src/solaris-net.bin); berserk-8 uses its avx2 release target (static, -mavx2): with -march=native on AVX-512 runners its AVX-512 path does 64-byte aligned loads on accumulators aligned to 32 and segfaults; altair is built with CXX=g++ because its makefile wants clang++ plus lld (g++ also turns its llvm PGO off), and it aborts on 'quit' (joinable std::thread destroyed), so the workflow smoke test accepts a nonzero exit when bestmove was printed; koivisto-8.0/9.0 fetch the net their tag's networks submodule pins (net_url + net_sha256; 9.0's openbench target also runs a PGO bench). Excluded from the 3500-3650 additions: Ethereal 13.x/14 (NNUE nets are not public; 13.25/13.50/13.75 are not tagged), Seer 2.8.0 (3639, net is a replaceable release asset rather than a commit-pinned file, and it would duplicate koivisto-9.0's slot), Berserk 8.5 (its tag's makefile says VERSION=9-dev, so the tag may not be the tested build), Stormphrax (clang-oriented makefile; 4.0.0 was a fallback for the 3560 slot).
